releaseNotes: Cloudflare tunnel works on networks that block trycloudflare.com: the station now signs up for its quick tunnel through a PrintAway relay on Vercel when the direct sign-up is blocked, then runs over Cloudflare's normal edge. The watchdog reads cloudflared's own health status instead of opening the public link from the shop PC, so a busy or locally-blocked tunnel is no longer torn down (which changed the customer link); cloudflared re-dials dropped connections itself. localhost.run is only a backup and the station returns to Cloudflare within 15 minutes. Pinggy removed.
